en.meta_title: White Peeling: Chemical Peel for Hyperpigmentation & Sun Spots
en.meta_description: Achieve a brighter, more even skin tone with our White Peeling treatment. This advanced chemical peel targets hyperpigmentation, including sun spots, age spots, and melasma, to reveal a clearer, more luminous complexion.
en.meta_keywords: chemical peel, hyperpigmentation treatment, sun spot removal, age spots, melasma treatment, even skin tone, skin lightening

what_is.heading: What is White Peeling? Targeting Hyperpigmentation
paragraphs: Achieve a brighter, more even, and luminous skin tone with our specialized White Peeling treatment. This advanced chemical peel is specifically formulated to target various forms of hyperpigmentation, including sun spots, age spots, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation from acne, and melasma.

how_it_works.heading: How It Works
paragraphs: The peel contains a blend of potent yet safe lightening agents that work to inhibit melanin production and gently lift away existing discolored cells from the skin's surface. This process accelerates cell turnover, revealing the clearer, more radiant skin underneath.

results.heading: Restoring Skin Clarity
paragraphs: Our White Peeling treatment is a perfect choice for restoring skin clarity and tackling stubborn pigmentation that doesn't respond to topical creams alone. A series of peels is often recommended for the most dramatic and lasting improvement in skin tone. Our skincare experts will create a customized treatment plan to protect your results.
